key: ???: Hey, wrecking ball!
en: ???: Hey, wrecking ball!
ja: ???: おーい、解体屋!

key: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
en: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
ja: シャルロット: いたいた。

key: My sister dropped me off down here to look for you; we got a job.
en: My sister dropped me off down here to look for you; we got a job.
ja: お姉ちゃんに下まで送ってもらってあんたを探しに来たの。仕事があるから。

key: According to the chatterboxes in Team Meteor, they already collapsed all the routes further in,
en: According to the chatterboxes in Team Meteor, they already collapsed all the routes further in,
ja: チームメテオのおしゃべりどもによると、もう奥への道は全部崩してあるらしいけど、

key: Except for the one right behind that nest they camped up on.
en: Except for the one right behind that nest they camped up on.
ja: あいつらが陣取ってるあの巣のすぐ裏の道だけは別みたい。

key: CHARLOTTE: If I were more naive, I'd say it was almost smart of them.
en: CHARLOTTE: If I were more naive, I'd say it was almost smart of them.
ja: シャルロット: あたしがもっとうぶだったら、あいつらもなかなか頭使ったなって言うところね。

key: The whole platform is raised so high up they can see the entire room and attack any point necessary,
en: The whole platform is raised so high up they can see the entire room and attack any point necessary,
ja: 台座全体がすごく高い位置にあるから、部屋全体が見渡せて、どこでも必要な場所を攻撃できる。

key: All while remaining out of the reach of any opposition barring fliers.
en: All while remaining out of the reach of any opposition barring fliers.
ja: しかも飛行系以外の反撃はまず届かない場所にいるってわけ。

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Which would include my sister, but she took a hit trying to protect me before I knew what was going on.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Which would include my sister, but she took a hit trying to protect me before I knew what was going on.
ja: シャルロット: …それにはお姉ちゃんも含まれてたはずなんだけど、あたしが気づく前に、あたしを守ろうとして一撃食らっちゃって。

key: Don't worry; she's fine.
en: Don't worry; she's fine.
ja: 心配しないで、無事だから。

key: She just needs some time to heal up.
en: She just needs some time to heal up.
ja: ちょっと治療の時間が必要なだけ。

key: But that means it's up to us.
en: But that means it's up to us.
ja: つまり、あたしたちでやるしかないってこと。

key: And we have a plan.
en: And we have a plan.
ja: で、作戦はあるの。

key: CHARLOTTE: Like I said, that stone nest is almost smart.
en: CHARLOTTE: Like I said, that stone nest is almost smart.
ja: シャルロット: さっきも言った通り、あの石の巣はなかなか頭を使ってる。

key: But there's a glaring weakness.
en: But there's a glaring weakness.
ja: でも、露骨な弱点がある。

key: It's only supported by a single rock pillar beneath it.
en: It's only supported by a single rock pillar beneath it.
ja: 下から支えてるのは、たった一本の岩の柱だけ。

key: You know where this is going, right?
en: You know where this is going, right?
ja: 話の続きはわかるよね?

key: CHARLOTTE: And as some luck would have it,
en: CHARLOTTE: And as some luck would have it,
ja: シャルロット: それに、運がいいことに、

key: There's explosives lying around all over this place.
en: There's explosives lying around all over this place.
ja: この辺一帯に爆薬が転がってるの。

key: Not sure whether Team Meteor just left 'em when they were done with their bit, or if they were already here.
en: Not sure whether Team Meteor just left 'em when they were done with their bit, or if they were already here.
ja: チームメテオが自分たちの用が済んで置いてったのか、元々ここにあったのかは知らないけど。

key: Apparently this place is a historical mine or whatever.
en: Apparently this place is a historical mine or whatever.
ja: どうやらここ、歴史的な鉱山かなんからしいし。

key: They say the crystal keys Meteor has been chasing since forever ago were originally cut from the stone of this place,
en: They say the crystal keys Meteor has been chasing since forever ago were originally cut from the stone of this place,
ja: メテオがずっと昔から追いかけてる結晶の鍵は、元々ここの石から切り出されたものだって話。

key: Or something. I don't care.
en: Or something. I don't care.
ja: とかなんとか。どうでもいいけど。

key: But I guess it makes sense miners might have used explosives for whatever,
en: But I guess it makes sense miners might have used explosives for whatever,
ja: まあ、鉱夫たちが何かのために爆薬を使ってたとしても不思議じゃないか。

key: Especially if they had a death wish.
en: Especially if they had a death wish.
ja: 特に死にたがってたなら尚更。

key: And I know I do.
en: And I know I do.
ja: で、あたしはそうだから。

key: I wish death for Team Meteor.
en: I wish death for Team Meteor.
ja: チームメテオには死んでほしいもの。

key: I'll get started while you find a way up here.
en: I'll get started while you find a way up here.
ja: あんたが上まで来る道を探してる間に、あたしは準備始めとくから。

key: Let's make Julia proud.
en: Let's make Julia proud.
ja: ジュリアに誇ってもらえるようにやろう。

key: A pile of loose rocks sits near the tracks.
en: A pile of loose rocks sits near the tracks.
ja: 線路のそばに崩れた岩の山がある。

key: Empty the cart?
en: Empty the cart?
ja: トロッコを空にする?

key: Fill up the cart?
en: Fill up the cart?
ja: トロッコに積む?

key: They could probably be moved if a cart were nearby.
en: They could probably be moved if a cart were nearby.
ja: 近くにトロッコがあれば動かせそうだ。

key: The challenges I've overcome...
en: The challenges I've overcome...
ja: 乗り越えてきた試練の数々…

key: The places we've seen through this journey...
en: The places we've seen through this journey...
ja: この旅で見てきた景色の数々…

key: My dream has become a reality.
en: My dream has become a reality.
ja: 私の夢が現実になった。

key: An old area map is posted here...
en: An old area map is posted here...
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている…

key: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
en: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
ja: …でも、もう正確ではないようだ。

key: Skip minecart puzzle?
en: Skip minecart puzzle?
ja: トロッコパズルをスキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
